apis.name: IIE Library · EZproxy sign-in
apis.why: Gateway to every licensed library database. A GET only renders the Shibboleth redirect page - no credentials are sent and no session is created.

apis.name: STASY · Apply Now form
apis.why: The single largest shared dependency in the estate. 15 sites open this to start an application, so if it fails, applications break everywhere at once while every site still looks perfectly healthy.

apis.name: STASY · Enquiry form
apis.why: Twelve sites route enquiries through this. Same blast radius as apply-now.

apis.name: STASY · Platform root
apis.why: Distinguishes 'the whole STASY platform is down' from 'one form on it is broken'.
